{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper handling of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
print("Sentinel values in `revenue`:", sales_df['revenue'].unique())

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify the conversion
print("After conversion, revenue dtype:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Missing values in revenue after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())"}
